turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?

turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any changes in the shape or contour of my breasts, and nothing looks different from before. I’m not experiencing any related discomfort or skin changes there.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I’m not having any abdominal pain or discomfort. I feel fine otherwise, aside from the rough, scaly plaque on my left dorsal hand.”

turns.patient_answer: “Not really, doctor—my energy level feels about the same as usual. I haven’t been feeling weak or run-down, and my everyday activities are fine.”
